gaps.sentence: ___ had the meeting begun than the fire alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: No sooner … than: the pair begins with 'No'.

gaps.sentence: So difficult ___ the exam that half the candidates failed.
gaps.explanation: So difficult was the exam that… — inversion for emphasis.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Seldom have I been so ___ by a performance.
gaps.explanation: 'moved' — the audience was emotionally affected; inversion with have been.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely ___ the ink dried before the rumours started.
gaps.explanation: Scarcely had X happened before Y — like hardly… when.

gaps.sentence: Rarely ___ this metro line run this late.
gaps.explanation: Rarely at the front: does + subject + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Never before ___ the city seen flooding on this scale.
gaps.explanation: Never before had the city seen… — past perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not until the film ended ___ anybody speak.
gaps.explanation: Not until + time clause at the front: did anybody speak.
